# Bonar1

> Bonar1 is the shared domain for the public work of Etgar and Adi Bonar. The sites are independent destinations, not divisions of one company.

## Main pages

- [Bonar1 home](https://bonar1.com/): English directory of the public sites.
- [Bonar1 in Hebrew](https://bonar1.com/he/): Hebrew directory of the public sites.

## Public properties

- [Etgar Bonar](https://etgar.bonar1.com/): Revenue and go-to-market executive profile, career record and commercial point of view.
- [The cost-to-serve line](https://etgar.bonar1.com/five-layers/): Etgar Bonar's point of view on AI-mediated customer journeys.
- [Private AI](https://ai.bonar1.com/): A private personal AI operating layer for individuals and families.
- [Private AI questions](https://ai.bonar1.com/faq/): Direct answers about the working system, its boundaries, reliability and security approach.
- [Adi Dwek Bonar](https://adi.bonar1.com/): Psychoanalytic psychotherapy for children, adolescents and their parents.

## Scope

- Bonar1 is a routing hub. Canonical detail belongs on each linked property.
- The hub does not represent Bonar1 as a company or organization.
